Hi Alex — thanks for hopping on earlier. It sounds like your calendar conflict meant we couldn't get into the ops details and introduce Ben (our solutions engineer), so I wanted to capture the quick recap and propose a tight rebook so we can move this forward this week.

Recap (2 mins):
- Goals: confirm throughput and data isolation needs for pilot; dependency list for POC (S3, VPC peering)
- Open items: security questionnaire answers (we have draft), list of datasets and retention requirements
- Attendees next call: Alex, Dana (ops), Ben (SE), me — 30 minutes recommended

Proposed short slots (all PST):
1) Thu 11/19 09:00–09:30
2) Thu 11/19 11:00–11:30
3) Fri 11/20 14:00–14:30 (fallback)

Quick ask: can you confirm one of the first two slots by EOD today? If we don't hear back we'll release them and open the calendar next week — Ben is tight next week because of an all-hands.

Attached a one-pager (demo-1-pager.pdf) and an initial SOW stub (SOW-draft-v1.pdf) so Dana can eyeball scope.

Thanks,

Alex / Dana — Ben here. 11:00–11:30 PST on Thu 11/19 works for me. Plan: 15m quick demo focused on throughput/latency for your typical 10–20 concurrent requests, then 15m ops Q&A (VPC, KMS, retention).

Pre-call ask (2 bullets):
- Can you share a sample payload size and expected peak RPS (simple numbers are fine)
- Confirm whether you expect to keep keys in your KMS (yes/no) or want us to manage keys for the pilot

I will send a calendar invite and drop a 1-page flow diagram in the event (will include S3 pull vs push and where KV caching sits). If anyone prefers a separate deep-dive with infra, we can book a follow-up with engineering.
